desc: Retrieve per-user Slackbot tool usage for an Enterprise organization on a single date, returned as paginated JSON.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

date.desc: The date to retrieve the analytics data for, expressed as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC. If not provided, defaults to the latest date with available data. The response's `available_date_range` gives the earliest and latest dates you can request.

cursor.desc: Paginate through collections of data by setting the `cursor` parameter to a `next_cursor` attribute returned by a previous request's `response_metadata`. Default value fetches the first "page" of the collection.

limit.desc: Maximum number of tool entries to return per page, counted across all rows. Defaults to 500. Max allowed is 1000.

date.desc: The date the rows cover, as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC: the `date` argument, the date the `cursor` was issued for, or the latest date with available data when both were omitted. Omitted when no Slackbot analytics data is available yet.

available_date_range.desc: The dates this method has data for. `start_date` is the earliest `date` it accepts and `end_date` the latest, which is also the default. Omitted when no Slackbot analytics data is available yet.

start_date.desc: The earliest date with data, as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC (inclusive).

end_date.desc: The latest date with data, as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC (inclusive).

tool_usage.desc: One row per user for whom Slackbot used at least one user-facing tool on the date. When a page ends partway through a user's tools, the rest continue in a row with the same `user_id` at the start of the next page, so merge rows that share it.

date.desc: The date this row of data is representative of, expressed as `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC.

enterprise_id.desc: Unique ID of the involved Enterprise organization

user_id.desc: The canonical, organization-wide user ID this row concerns

email_address.desc: The email address of record for the same user. Omitted when the organization hides email addresses, and for guests when the organization hides guest email addresses.

tools.desc: User-facing tools Slackbot used on the user's behalf on this date

name.desc: The display name of the tool

use_count.desc: Number of times Slackbot used the tool for the user on this date

next_cursor.desc: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Empty when there are no more results.

feature_not_available.desc: Slackbot analytics is not available for this organization.

invalid_arguments.desc: Required arguments either were not provided or contain invalid values, including a `date` that is not a real calendar day.

invalid_cursor.desc: Value passed for `cursor` was not valid, or was issued for a different `date`.

date_before_created_date.desc: `date` is before the organization was created.

data_not_available_for_date.desc: Analytics are not available for `date`. Call the method without `date` and use `available_date_range` from the response to find the supported dates.

not_an_enterprise.desc: The token does not belong to an Enterprise organization.

restricted_plan_level.desc: The enterprise plan level does not have access to this feature.

restricted_action.desc: The token does not have permission to access Slackbot analytics.

internal_error.desc: Something went wrong on our end, please try again.

success.description: Successful response with one page of per-user tool usage. The second row omits `email_address` because the organization hides guest email addresses.

error.description: Error response when `date` is not a real date
